Equity Research
Flash Comment — March 9, 2026
U.S. Software
Microsoft Corporation
Agentic Adoption Hinges on Security; E7 SKU Presents 
$100B Upsell Opportunity
Overweight
Price Target: $615.00
  
Our Call
Leveraging its signif E3 + E5 installed base, MSFT's new E7 SKU + merchandising muscle 
could prove a catalyst for broader M365 Copilot & Agent 365 adoption into C2H26. We est 
325M seats addressable, inc. 150M M365E3/E5 or $100B potential upsell opp.
 
Initial Thoughts
Agent 365, E7 'Frontier Suite' SKU, and Copilot Wave 3: MSFT this morning announced 
a trio of M365 advancements:
1. Agent 365 announced at $15 per user per month, a control plane for managing 
agents. New SKU will be generally available on May 1, 2026.
2. New E7 SKU announced at $99 per user per month, incl M365 E5, Entra Suite, 
Agent 365, and M365 Copilot. New SKU will be generally available on May 1, 2026.
3. M365 Copilot Wave 3 released, built in "close collaboration" with Anthropic's Cowork.
 
 
Expect E7 bundle upsells drive M365 Copilot, Agent 365 adoption; price hikes timely:
New Agent 365 offer brings agent registry/agent ID (in Entra), observability, risk signals, 
etc.—all important prerequisites for agentic adoption. Similar to M365 Copilot, see Agent 
365 adoption as unlikely standalone (via $30/mo, $15/mo SKUs) and instead expect 
both see accelerated adoption via E7 SKU. Note: recent M365 price hikes already force 
enterprise negotiations in 2H26, creating NT adoption catalyst.

And we continue to make great progress with our Phi family of SLMs, which now
have been downloaded over 60 million times, up 3x year-over-year. Beyond models and Foundry,
we're providing everything developers need to design, customize and manage AI applications
and agents at scale. Our new Microsoft Agent Framework helps developers orchestrate multi-
agent systems with compliance, observability and deep integration out-of-the-box. For example,
KPMG used the Framework to modernize the audit process connecting agents to internal data
with enterprise-grade governance and observability. These kinds of real production scale AI
deployments are driving Azure's overall growth. And once again, this quarter, Azure took share.
Now, let's turn to applications and agents we ourselves are building on this platform. We now
have 900 million monthly active users of our AI features across our products. And our first-party
family of Copilots now has surpassed 150 million monthly active users across information work,
coding, security, science, health and consumer. When it comes to information work, we continue
to innovate with Microsoft 365 Copilot. Copilot is becoming the UI for the agentic AI experience.

PowerPoint and Teams. Just nine months since release, tens of millions of users across Microsoft
365 customer base are already using chat. Adoption is accelerating rapidly, growing 50% quarter-
